definition: a person on one side of a court case
description: A wood-panelled courtroom with tall arched windows. An older judge in a black robe reads a paper at the high bench under a green lamp. At the tables in front, a young woman in a navy suit covers her mouth in shock while the woman beside her puts a hand on her back, then she stands up and turns to lean over the table towards that woman. On the other side a man in a grey suit holds his head in both hands. A clerk types on a laptop, files lie on the tables, and people watch from the benches.

en.question: What is the man in grey doing?

de.answer: Er hält sich den Kopf mit beiden Händen.
de.question: Was macht der Mann in Grau?

es.answer: Se está agarrando la cabeza con las manos.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre de gris?

fr.answer: Il se tient la tête entre les mains.
fr.question: Que fait l'homme en gris ?
